tools.label: ONDA | NEW TAB
tools.description: Open Onda in the basin iframe or launch Onda in a new browser tab.

splitTools.label: ONDA
splitTools.description: Open Onda inside the Organon workspace.

splitTools.label: NEW TAB
splitTools.description: Open Onda in a new browser tab.

tools.label: IHY
tools.description: Create local sound effects, play an editable music grid, import audio references and export Ihy project JSON.

tools.label: ORGAVOX
tools.description: Local browser audio workstation for layering MP3, WAV or video audio across ten waveform tracks, trimming, splitting, stretching, adding effects, fading, normalizing and exporting WAV or MP3 mixes.

tools.label: AUDIO2MIDI
tools.description: Convert audio material into MIDI-style note data where browser processing allows.

tools.label: ANIMATION MAKER
tools.description: Create and preview animation assets with accurate source-frame capture, real per-frame timing, reversible advanced background removal, outside-only chroma cleanup, black-matte repair, despeckling, browser-remembered settings, safe alpha-only shadows, ordered frame export and direct folder saving.

tools.label: AUDIO TIMELINE
tools.description: Assemble short AI video clips with generated audio and export a browser-rendered timeline.

tools.label: FRAME EXTRACTOR
tools.description: Extract still frames from local video files.

tools.label: VIDCOMPRESSOR
tools.description: Compress or convert single videos or queued batches to MP4 or OGV with live estimates, shared video/audio settings, sequential processing and direct saving to an authorised output folder.

tools.label: BUBBLE RISER
tools.description: Create loopable black-background bubble fields, streams, emitters and bursts, then export MP4 or animated WebP.

tools.label: ALPHA ISOLATOR
tools.description: Isolate, refine, and export alpha-channel image transparency.

tools.label: MULTI EDIT
tools.description: Apply shared crop, resize, colour, opacity and chromakey edits to multiple images, erase matching transparent areas across the full batch with Box, Lasso or Pen tools, adjust pen size with a live circular cursor, undo or clear erase masks, and export transparency-preserving PNG or WebP files.

tools.label: TILE IMAGE
tools.description: Slice and tile images into precise, custom grid coordinates.

tools.label: IMG2NORMAL
tools.description: Convert images into normal maps for 3D rendering.

tools.label: JPEG COMPRESS
tools.description: Compress JPEG images to optimized file sizes.

tools.label: ICON SLICER
tools.description: Slice icon sheets or source graphics into individual icon assets.

tools.label: AUTO CUT
tools.description: Detect transparency islands, smart-filter tiny artefacts, sort and manage detections, inspect, multi-select, duplicate and delete outlines in a zoom editor, propagate numbered names in bulk, and export isolated PNG or WebP assets.

tools.label: SIMPLESPRITE
tools.description: Position large source images inside a custom crop canvas, display a grid and exact-centre X, erase temporary transparency, auto-frame transparent-separated sprites, build a set, preview a saved sprite as a 50% alignment overlay, and export numbered transparent PNG files.

tools.label: BULK CONVERT
tools.description: Convert multiple local files in batch, preserve PNG/WebP transparency and save converted files directly to a selected folder.

tools.label: SIMPLE PREVIEW
tools.description: Preview local 2D, 3D, and media assets in a universal viewer.

tools.label: IMAGE CALCULATOR
tools.description: Calculate image dimensions and filters with aspect-safe previews, then use Palette & Picker to extract colours, generate design palettes, recolour screenshots and switch to a separate fullscreen workspace.

tools.label: BULK DOWNLOAD
tools.description: Download multiple files or assets in batch.

tools.label: FILESCAN
tools.description: List local folder filenames or switch to the separate File Rename module for top-level batch renaming and ZIP export.

tools.label: FILEDELETR
tools.description: Mount a local folder, intelligently match pasted filenames, resolve similar candidates, then archive or delete selected exact matches.

tools.label: LOCA DATE CALC
tools.description: Calculate local dates and date offsets for planning workflows.

tools.label: INFO
tools.description: Open the Organon system information and design manual.

tools.label: CAPSULARIUS
tools.description: Open the local-first project workspace for folders and project assets.

tools.label: CODE EDITOR | REPOSITORY
tools.description: Open the code editor or repository from the split copper button.

splitTools.label: CODE EDITOR
splitTools.description: Open the Organon code editor workspace.

tools.label: QUICKSHEET
tools.description: Launch Quicksheet in a new browser tab.

splitTools.label: QUICKSHEET
splitTools.description: Open the Quicksheet CSV, XLSX and XLS editor in a new browser tab.

tools.label: CHARACTER LIBRARY
tools.description: Browse and manage the global character library sheet metadata.
